prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a sideswipe while changing lanes in Conroe, Texas, and has shoulder injury. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1304; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Please state your full name for the record.
A: [Claimant Name].

Q: Thank you. Where were you when the collision occurred?
A: I was on the highway in Conroe, Texas, heading toward the north side of town. I was in the right lane and needed to move over to the left lane because my exit was coming up.

Q: Walk me through what happened as you changed lanes.
A: I checked my mirror, I saw the lane looked clear, so I signaled and started moving over. About halfway into the lane, I felt a bump on my left side and heard a loud scraping noise. The other car had come up in my blind spot and clipped my door.

Q: Did you see the other vehicle before you moved over?
A: Not in my mirror. I glanced at my mirror and didn't see anything, but I didn't do a shoulder check before I moved. I should have.

Q: Did the other driver say anything at the scene?
A: They said they didn't see me either. We both pulled onto the shoulder, and they gave me their insurance information.

Q: Were you injured?
A: Yes. I hit my right shoulder on the door frame and the seatbelt caught me hard across the chest. My shoulder has been sore since, and I can't lift my arm above my head without pain.

Q: Have you seen a doctor or received any treatment?
A: I went to urgent care that same afternoon. They took X-rays and told me to follow up with an orthopedic specialist. I have an appointment scheduled, and I'm doing physical therapy exercises at home.

Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add?
A: Only that I'm willing to cooperate fully. I want this handled fairly, and I'll send over the medical records and the photos I took at the scene.
